sam: Heads-up: saw a spike in generated tokens for a few interactive calls. Root cause looks like frontdoor retrying mid-stream to a different slice so prefix is recomputed.

nina: Saw that too in traces. Hedge + cold-KV = double work.

omar: Quick thought: add a lightweight stream id so backends can dedupe when retries/hedges arrive.

sam: Proposal: frontdoor emits `X-Stream-Id: <signed-uuid>` and `X-Stream-Seq` for chunk ordering. Upstreams do a set-if-not-exists marker keyed by stream id with a short TTL. If marker already present, backend returns `409` plus trailer `Stream-Action: resumed`.

ryan: That handles retries and hedges if backends do CAS on marker. Concern: marker-store cross-slice coordination cost. Start with in-memory per-slice CAS + optional central store for full coordination.

nina: Also add prefer-same-slice retry window (e.g., 8s). Policy: prefer original slice if healthy and warm_flag=true; otherwise fallback.

omar: Security: sign X-Stream-Id (HMAC route key in KMS) so clients can't spoof. Also rate-limit acceptance.

sam: Telemetry fields to add: `stream_id`, `dedupe_outcome` (`computed|resumed|conflict`), `replay_tokens`. That lets finance see token deltas from retries.

ryan: Ops plan: feature flag on frontdoor + middleware on subset of slices. Canary to 5% traffic. Watch dedupe_conflicts, replay_tokens_pct, and latency due to CAS.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI PR #4412 touched frontdoor routing last night; rollout 10%.

sam: Cool. I'll draft a short RFC with headers, trailer examples, CAS pseudo-code, and canary checklist. Need volunteers: nina for telemetry spec, ryan for SRE marker sizing, omar for security review.

nina: I'll do telemetry.

omar: Security review OK, will propose HMAC scheme.

ryan: I'll handle marker-store canary and rollback plan.

sam: Thanks everyone — will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
